title: hangar.harness-lock/v1
description: A harness lock (docs/harness-lock.md, spec 0014 §2): the native files of a harness directory pinned by content digest, the CLI version, the concrete model, and the binding layer (names, never values). YAML on disk (harness.lock); identity is harness_digest, the lock projected onto hangar.manifest/v1's harness sections and digested in spec 0014 §2's canonical form. name, revision, paths and provenance are not identity.

path.description: Relative to the harness directory; no '..', no absolute paths.

then.description: A reference: its source, no path.

id.description: kind:name. guide:<file> (the harness's global instructions file), skill:<name>, plugin:<name>@<marketplace>, native:<runtime>/<path>.

digest.description: A file's: sha256 of its bytes. A skill's directory: manifest._dir_digest, i.e. sha256 over, for each file in path order, its relative path, a NUL and the raw sha256 of its content. A plugin's: plugins.content_digest, sha256 over its marketplace entry (canonical JSON), a newline and its directory's _dir_digest (#221). Equal to the manifest's declared digest. null only for a reference (source, no path): a pinned git skill, hangar's own verify-ui.

tree.description: Skills and plugins: what the sandbox probe reports for these files (manifest skills.effective[].digest, probe.plugins[].digest), so drift can be checked without the source (#134, #221).

source.description: Where it came from (provenance, not identity): path:<env-relative path>, git:<url>, hangar:computer.

enabled.description: Plugins: whether it is enabled (default true).

revision.description: Monotonic; freeze bumps it when anything but the name changes. Not identity.

version.description: The CLI version from harnesses.lock.yaml (manifest harness.locked).

pack.description: The pack image the turn ran (provenance).

id.description: The resolved concrete model id; the only model field in identity.

policy.description: The policy it was resolved from (frontier, balanced): never identity.

components.description: In order: the guide, then skills in the order the turn declared them, then native fragments.

binding.description: Rendered at claim. Names, never values: credentials stay in the environment.

endpoint.description: http: the URL without user info, query or fragment.

source.description: Who adds it when not the environment (computer).
